missions.title: An energy-use question
paragraphs: A team proposes a change to reduce electricity use. The current level of use has not been measured. The people involved need enough information to choose a practical response.

A small environmental change is easier to maintain when it fits the place and the people using it. A new sign, container or routine should be clear enough to use without a long explanation. Trying the change on a small scale gives people a chance to notice difficulties and improve the arrangement before asking everyone to follow it.
